querystring.select: SELECT RC.COUNTRY_NAME AS CountryName, CP.CUST_FULL_NAME AS CustFullName, C.CUST_ID AS CustId, RMSAL.DESCR AS MrSalutationCode, CP.CUST_PREFIX_NAME AS CustPrefixName, CP.CUST_SUFFIX_NAME AS CustSuffixName, RMNAT.DESCR AS MrNationalityCode, RC.COUNTRY_NAME AS WnaCountryCode, RMEDU.DESCR AS MrEducationCode, RMREG.DESCR AS MrReligionCode, CP.NICK_NAME AS NickName, RMMAR.DESCR AS MrMaritalStatCode, CP.NO_OF_DEPENDENTS AS NoOfDependents, CP.NO_OF_RESIDENCE AS NoOfResidence, CP.FAMILY_CARD_NO AS FamilyCardNo, CP.MOTHER_MAIDEN_NAME AS MotherMaidenName, CP.IS_REST_IN_PEACE AS IsRestInPeace
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST_PERSONAL CP WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.CUST C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CUST_ID = CP.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_COUNTRY RC WITH(NOLOCK) ON RC.COUNTRY_CODE = CP.WNA_COUNTRY_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMSAL WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMSAL.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'SALUTATION' AND RMSAL.MASTER_CODE = CP.MR_SALUTATION_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMEDU WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMEDU.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'EDUCATION' AND RMEDU.MASTER_CODE = CP.MR_EDUCATION_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMNAT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMNAT.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'NATIONALITY' AND RMNAT.MASTER_CODE = CP.MR_NATIONALITY_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMREG WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMREG.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'RELIGION' AND RMREG.MASTER_CODE = CP.MR_RELIGION_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMMAR WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMMAR.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'MARITAL_STAT' AND RMMAR.MASTER_CODE = CP.MR_MARITAL_STAT_CODE
